newsitem.title: USA: Greenspan sees possible faster long-term growth.
newsitem.headline: Greenspan sees possible faster long-term growth.

text.p: The extraordinary expansion of computers and other high-technology goods may be leading to faster economic growth in the longer run, Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan said on Wednesday.
But that does not mean that the business cycle has been abolished, he told the Senate Banking Committee.

While the ups and downs of the business cycle probably have been dampened by better control of inventories, Greenspan said he would be careful about pursuing that argument too far because financial factors remain variable.
